analysis: The only change in this PR is documentation in docs/developer/test.md, head lines 142-153. The supplied units are base_text at lines 1386-2303, well away from the changed range, and show no changed text. The patch revises the CI build-cache description: only pushes to dev or master save a build, and pull requests restore but never save. It also adds a note that the MiMo audio gate (testNativeAudioRelease) runs only when its inputs change or on a master push. No provider code, protocol, key handling, attestation, App Attest authorization, prefix-cache storage (T-041), fan helper or add-on socket behavior changes. The edit touches no runtime security control and does not alter any mitigation in the threat model. The cache change reduces the cache-poisoning surface slightly, because PR builds can no longer write cache entries. The CI paths and scripts the doc mentions (scripts/ci-component-paths.py, build.md#ci-caching) are outside the supplied evidence, so their actual behavior is unverified. That is a documentation-accuracy question, not a security regression. I found no new attack surface and no invalidated threat assumptions, and no threat-model update is needed.
